map.输入体重、日常活动水平（久坐至高强度）与训练目标（增肌、减脂或维持），依据生理常: Enter body weight, daily activity level (sedentary to high intensity), and training goal (muscle gain, fat loss, or maintenance); estimate the recommended daily protein intake range (g) from physiological constants and empirical coefficients, helping fitness people plan dietary protein.

map.把克数换算成食物份数（鸡蛋/鸡胸），便于日常执行。: Convert grams to food portions (egg/chicken breast), easy daily execution.
map.可复现算例：70 kg 规律训练者蛋白需求: Reproducible example: 70 kg regular trainer protein need
: input: weight 70 kg, activity 'regular training' 1.6 g/kg, goal 'muscle gain' +0.2.
coefficient factor = 1.6 + 0.2 = 1.8 g/kg; lower bound minFactor = max(0.8, 1.8 - 0.2) = 1.6, upper bound maxFactor = 1.8 + 0.2 = 2.0.
daily protein range = 70 x 1.6 ~ 70 x 2.0 = 112-140 g.
roughly equivalent to 112/6 approx 19 ~ 140/6 approx 23 eggs' protein (about 6 g each), or 112/30 approx 4 ~ 140/30 approx 5 chicken-breast servings (about 30 g protein each).
map.蛋白系数怎么选？: How to choose the protein coefficient?
map.久坐 0.8、轻度 1.0、中度 1.3、规律训练 1.6、高强度/增肌 2.0: Sedentary 0.8, light 1.0, moderate 1.3, regular training 1.6, high intensity/muscle gain 2.0 g/kg; fat loss preserving muscle or muscle gain extra +0.2. This tool gives a range not a fixed value, easy to fine-tune by daily training volume.
